title: statice limonium subsp. bahusiensis
intro: Statice limonium subsp. bahusiensis, commonly known as Bahus' statice, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Plumbaginaceae. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The plant has been used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and gastrointestinal problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Statice limonium subsp. bahusiensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
